name: popover
title: Popover
description: Anchored floating surface built on ui-sdk, for rich interactive controls outside dialogs.
docs: Control open state with v-model:open when needed. Use PopoverTrigger with as-child to wrap a Button. PopoverContent supports side, align, sideOffset and trapFocus, and renders at z-50 with the popup shadow.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Popover as PopoverRoot } from '@ui-sdk/vue/popover'
import { provide, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue'
import { popoverContext } from './context'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type PopoverProps = {
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  /** Disables interaction with outside elements while open. */
  modal?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<PopoverProps>(), {
  defaultOpen: undefined,
  modal: false,
})

const open = defineModel<boolean>('open')
const trapFocus = ref(false)
provide(popoverContext, { anchor: shallowRef<HTMLElement>(), trapFocus })
</script>

<template>
  <PopoverRoot
    v-model:open="open"
    :default-open="defaultOpen"
    :modal="modal || (trapFocus ? 'trap-focus' : false)"
    v-bind="$attrs"
  >
    <slot />
  </PopoverRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component } from 'vue'
import { PopoverTrigger as SdkPopoverTrigger } from '@ui-sdk/vue/popover'
import { RenderChild } from '@/lib/render-child'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type PopoverTriggerProps = {
  as?: string | Component
  asChild?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<PopoverTriggerProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  asChild: false,
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkPopoverTrigger v-bind="$attrs" :class="!asChild && 'h-auto border-0 bg-transparent p-0'">
    <template #render="{ props: part }">
      <RenderChild v-if="asChild" v-bind="part"><slot /></RenderChild>
      <component :is="as" v-else v-bind="part"><slot /></component>
    </template>
  </SdkPopoverTrigger>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component } from 'vue'
import { inject, useTemplateRef, watchEffect, type ComponentPublicInstance } from 'vue'
import { RenderChild } from '@/lib/render-child'
import { popoverContext } from './context'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type PopoverAnchorProps = {
  as?: string | Component
  asChild?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<PopoverAnchorProps>(), {
  as: 'div',
  asChild: false,
})

const context = inject(popoverContext)
const anchor = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement | ComponentPublicInstance>('anchor')
watchEffect((onCleanup) => {
  if (!context || !anchor.value) return
  const value = anchor.value instanceof HTMLElement ? anchor.value : anchor.value.$el
  if (!(value instanceof HTMLElement)) return
  context.anchor.value = value
  onCleanup(() => {
    if (context.anchor.value === value) context.anchor.value = undefined
  })
})
</script>

<template>
  <RenderChild v-if="asChild" ref="anchor" v-bind="$attrs"><slot /></RenderChild>
  <component :is="as" v-else ref="anchor" v-bind="$attrs"><slot /></component>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component } from 'vue'
import { PopoverClose as SdkPopoverClose } from '@ui-sdk/vue/popover'
import { RenderChild } from '@/lib/render-child'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type PopoverCloseProps = {
  as?: string | Component
  asChild?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<PopoverCloseProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  asChild: false,
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkPopoverClose v-bind="$attrs" :class="!asChild && 'h-auto border-0 bg-transparent p-0'">
    <template #render="{ props: part }">
      <RenderChild v-if="asChild" v-bind="part"><slot /></RenderChild>
      <component :is="as" v-else v-bind="part"><slot /></component>
    </template>
  </SdkPopoverClose>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, onScopeDispose, useAttrs, watchEffect } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { PopoverContent as SdkPopoverContent } from '@ui-sdk/vue/popover'
import { popoverContext } from './context'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type PopoverContentProps = {
  align?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end'
  side?: 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left'
  sideOffset?: number
  trapFocus?: boolean
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<PopoverContentProps>(), {
  align: 'center',
  side: 'bottom',
  sideOffset: 8,
  trapFocus: false,
})

const context = inject(popoverContext)
const anchor = context?.anchor
if (context) {
  watchEffect(() => {
    context.trapFocus.value = props.trapFocus
  })
  onScopeDispose(() => {
    context.trapFocus.value = false
  })
}

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkPopoverContent
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :align="align"
    :side="side"
    :side-offset="sideOffset"
    :anchor="anchor"
    :class="
      cn(
        'z-50 w-72 rounded-panel border border-line bg-raised p-4 text-[14px] text-ink shadow-popup outline-none',
        'origin-[var(--transform-origin)]',
        'data-[side=bottom]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:-4px]',
        'data-[side=top]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:4px]',
        'data-[side=left]:[--p0seid0n-pop-x:4px] data-[side=left]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:0px]',
        'data-[side=right]:[--p0seid0n-pop-x:-4px] data-[side=right]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:0px]',
        'motion-safe:animate-pop-in data-ending-style:motion-safe:animate-pop-out',
        attrs.class as ClassValue,
      )
    "
  >
    <slot />
  </SdkPopoverContent>
</template>

export { default as Popover } from './Popover.vue'
export { default as PopoverTrigger } from './PopoverTrigger.vue'
export { default as PopoverAnchor } from './PopoverAnchor.vue'
export { default as PopoverClose } from './PopoverClose.vue'
export { default as PopoverContent } from './PopoverContent.vue'

export type { PopoverProps } from './Popover.vue'
export type { PopoverTriggerProps } from './PopoverTrigger.vue'
export type { PopoverAnchorProps } from './PopoverAnchor.vue'
export type { PopoverCloseProps } from './PopoverClose.vue'
export type { PopoverContentProps } from './PopoverContent.vue'
